name: Get answers
description: Reads back previously saved answers for the caller's open interview or latest resumable completed interview, optionally filtered by topic and/or question order. Includes the confirmed answer and rawUserMessages when stored. Read-only; use this as source data when building the final handover or when the revise path needs full history. Ambiguous or empty filters return structured flags without instructions. Each question carries its answer version in `sequence`, which is what revise_answer's expectedSequence expects.

inputFields.label: Question order
inputFields.description: Optional. Limit results to this question, by its order number within its topic. Question order repeats across topics, so pair it with topicOrder when the topic is known.

inputFields.label: Topic order
inputFields.description: Optional. Limit results to this topic, by its order number from the current state. Required alongside questionOrder if the question order alone matches more than one topic.
